import re, pathlib

 s=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
 defs=dict(re.findall(r'#define\s+(C_ASN1_[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?:_SIZE)?)\s+(\d+)', s))
 for m in re.finditer(r'static const struct sc_asn1_entry\s+(\w+)\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*=\s*\{', s):
  name, size=m.group(1),m.group(2).strip(); start=m.end(); depth=1; i=start
  while i<len(s) and depth:
   if s[i]=='{': depth+=1
   elif s[i]=='}': depth-=1
   i+=1
  body=s[start:i-1]
  # count top-level entries by lines starting { ignoring nested maybe
  entries=len(re.findall(r'^\s*\{', body, re.M))
  val=defs.get(size)
  if val and entries!=int(val): print(p, name, size, val, 'entries', entries)
